content:
morgan: deploy-bot blocked promotion for catalog-worker -> staging. error shows cache manifest TTL rotated mid-write and a shard returned 404. release window in ~20m, need quick unblock.

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion halted: artifact index checksum mismatch for catalog-worker:2026-03-10-rc3.
``nERROR PutObject shard-1 -> 404 Not Found
meta: expected=5c2d9e..., observed=UNKNOWN, cache-ttl=180s
```
lee: pin to last-good `catalog-worker:2026-03-05-rc8` is fastest. reupload will trigger cache warm and likely miss window.

ana: +1 pin. note in release notes and mark canary held.

sam: agree. rc8 had only a telemetry opt-in behind FF. no schema risk.

ben (release-manager): do pin + hold canary. i'll update notes and create follow-up ticket.

morgan: oncall — any chance to mirror-copy rc3 quickly?

lee (oncall): i'll start a parallel mirror copy now:
``ngsutil -m cp -r gs://artifacts-staging/tmp/catalog-worker/rc3/* gs://artifacts-staging/mirrors/catalog-worker/rc3/
```

deploy-bot: action: `promote --pin catalog-worker:2026-03-05-rc8` executed by ben at 1723510200. Canary: held (1/3). Mirror copy started.

ben: release notes updated: "pinned catalog-worker to 2026-03-05-rc8 due to artifact cache TTL rotation causing shard 404; rc3 mirror copy underway; will reconcile after release." Follow-up ticket: https://tracker.company/RED-4290

lee: mirror copy completed, checksums match expected. Since we've pinned, canary remains held until triage.

morgan: summary: pinned + canary held. triage scheduled tomorrow during post-release. closing thread for release window. :white_check_mark:
